bio.text: Gerald Greene was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 1982 and represents District 154, which includes Baker, Calhoun, Clay, Early, Miller, Quitman, Randolph and Seminole counties and part of Dougherty County.

The legislature biography says Greene taught social studies in the Randolph-Clay school system for 32 years and has also been an instructor of political science and western civilization at Andrew College.

Greene attended Andrew College, graduated from Georgia Southern University in 1970, and holds a master's in education from the University of Georgia and a master's in history from Georgia Southwestern.
